title: Form controls drawn as instruments
blurb: A radio group as a rotary switch, a number input as an odometer, a three-step form on a turning prism, a <meter> bent into a dial gauge and a time input with clock hands that can be dragged. Each control keeps its value, keyboard and validation.
question: Can a canvas draw a form control as a different machine (a switch, a counter, a prism, a gauge, a clock) while the real control still holds the value, takes the keyboard and validates?
result: Yes for all five. A 2D canvas has no perspective and no bend, so the prism and the gauge are drawn in strips, and the page makes one flat draw to place input. An outline is outside an element's picture, so the canvas draws the focus ring of the odometer.
